Results.ReviewText: This is a wonderful gas grill in every respect!  Build quality, sturdiness, design and most of all, grilling ability are excellent. Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my first propane grill, so I don’t have a lot for comparison. I’ve spent most of my life on a Weber charcoal grill, so the ease of starting and the fast warm up is a beautiful thing. Easy cleaning grill grates are great, a quick scrub with a wire brush after use. I always seem to need more counter space, but the spots on either side of the cooking area are certainly appreciated. I always hung my cooking tools in a conveniently located tree branch, now I too have finally graduated to utensil hooks below each prep space, which I like. I bought a cover for our grill, as I can’t imagine leaving it uncovered to the elements, my belief that a cover should be included with the grills’ purchase. I’ve used it only a handful of times so far, but each usage has been a much more streamlined experience than my years with a charcoal grill. The absence of charcoal is certainly noticed, for good and bad. It has been a built in part of the flavor of grilling my whole life, so it is certainly missed.
Results.Title: First propane grill

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
